query.rawQueryText: SELECT DISTINCT product FROM tasks ORDER BY product

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT product FROM tasks ORDER BY product

query.queryText: SELECT 'all' AS scope UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT scope FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' ORDER BY scope)
query.rawQueryText: SELECT 'all' AS scope UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT scope FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' ORDER BY scope)

list.definition: SELECT 'all' AS scope UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT scope FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' ORDER BY scope)

panels.title: Progress (agent hours)
panels.description: Agent hours: the factory's dev + QA + fix rounds, measured by /factory:build. The forecast applies this product's calibration (how much tasks typically overrun).

targets.queryText:
SELECT done || ' / ' || tasks AS "Tasks done", est_h AS "Estimate", spent_h AS "Spent",
  remaining_h AS "Remaining (by estimate)", forecast_h AS "Forecast remaining (calibrated)",
  est_human_h AS "Human-dev estimate", unestimated AS "Open tasks without estimate"
FROM summary WHERE product = '$product' AND scope = '$scope'
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT done || ' / ' || tasks AS "Tasks done", est_h AS "Estimate", spent_h AS "Spent",
  remaining_h AS "Remaining (by estimate)", forecast_h AS "Forecast remaining (calibrated)",
  est_human_h AS "Human-dev estimate", unestimated AS "Open tasks without estimate"
FROM summary WHERE product = '$product' AND scope = '$scope'

panels.title: Burn-down: remaining estimate vs time spent
panels.description: Daily. Remaining = estimates of open tasks minus time already spent on them.

targets.queryText:
SELECT time, remaining_est_h AS "Remaining (estimate)", spent_h AS "Spent (cumulative)", done_tasks AS "Tasks done"
FROM burndown WHERE product = '$product' AND scope = '$scope' ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT time, remaining_est_h AS "Remaining (estimate)", spent_h AS "Spent (cumulative)", done_tasks AS "Tasks done"
FROM burndown WHERE product = '$product' AND scope = '$scope' ORDER BY time

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(milestone, '(none)') AS Milestone, ROUND(SUM(cur_agent_h), 1) AS "Estimate",
  ROUND(SUM(actual_agent_h), 1) AS "Spent", ROUND(SUM(forecast_h), 1) AS "Forecast remaining"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE(milestone, '(none)') AS Milestone, ROUND(SUM(cur_agent_h), 1) AS "Estimate",
  ROUND(SUM(actual_agent_h), 1) AS "Spent", ROUND(SUM(forecast_h), 1) AS "Forecast remaining"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(story, '(no story)') AS Story, ROUND(SUM(cur_agent_h), 1) AS "Estimate",
  ROUND(SUM(actual_agent_h), 1) AS "Spent", ROUND(SUM(forecast_h), 1) AS "Forecast remaining"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE(story, '(no story)') AS Story, ROUND(SUM(cur_agent_h), 1) AS "Estimate",
  ROUND(SUM(actual_agent_h), 1) AS "Spent", ROUND(SUM(forecast_h), 1) AS "Forecast remaining"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText:
SELECT ref AS "Task", tid AS "ID", title AS "Title", status AS "Status", category AS "Category",
  cur_agent_h AS "Estimate h", actual_agent_h AS "Spent h", forecast_h AS "Forecast remaining h",
  CASE WHEN rev_agent_h IS NOT NULL THEN 'revised from ' || est_agent_h || 'h' ELSE '' END AS "Re-estimated"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') AND state != 'closed' ORDER BY forecast_h DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ref AS "Task", tid AS "ID", title AS "Title", status AS "Status", category AS "Category",
  cur_agent_h AS "Estimate h", actual_agent_h AS "Spent h", forecast_h AS "Forecast remaining h",
  CASE WHEN rev_agent_h IS NOT NULL THEN 'revised from ' || est_agent_h || 'h' ELSE '' END AS "Re-estimated"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') AND state != 'closed' ORDER BY forecast_h DESC

panels.title: Done tasks: estimate vs actual (biggest misses first)
panels.description: Deviation = actual agent time vs the estimate in force (revised if re-estimated). Human after (QA) = the QA reviewer's estimate, after seeing the PR, of what a human developer would have needed.

targets.queryText:
SELECT ref AS "Task", tid AS "ID", title AS "Title", category AS "Category",
  cur_agent_h AS "Estimate h", actual_agent_h AS "Actual h", deviation_pct AS "Deviation %",
  dev_h AS "Dev h", qa_h AS "QA h", fix_h AS "Fix h", fix_rounds AS "Fix rounds",
  cur_human_h AS "Human plan h", posthoc_human_h AS "Human after (QA) h"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') AND state = 'closed' AND tracked = 1 ORDER BY ABS(deviation_h) DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ref AS "Task", tid AS "ID", title AS "Title", category AS "Category",
  cur_agent_h AS "Estimate h", actual_agent_h AS "Actual h", deviation_pct AS "Deviation %",
  dev_h AS "Dev h", qa_h AS "QA h", fix_h AS "Fix h", fix_rounds AS "Fix rounds",
  cur_human_h AS "Human plan h", posthoc_human_h AS "Human after (QA) h"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') AND state = 'closed' AND tracked = 1 ORDER BY ABS(deviation_h) DESC

panels.title: Where the agent time goes
panels.description: dev = developer agents, qa = QA reviewer, fix = fix rounds after QA requested changes.

targets.queryText:
SELECT s.stage AS "Stage", ROUND(SUM(s.hours), 2) AS "Hours"
FROM stages s JOIN tasks t ON t.product = s.product AND t.ref = s.ref
WHERE s.product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR t.scope = '$scope') GROUP BY s.stage ORDER BY 2 DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT s.stage AS "Stage", ROUND(SUM(s.hours), 2) AS "Hours"
FROM stages s JOIN tasks t ON t.product = s.product AND t.ref = s.ref
WHERE s.product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR t.scope = '$scope') GROUP BY s.stage ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Deviation by category (total actual vs estimate, done tasks)

targets.queryText:
SELECT category AS "Category", ROUND(SUM(cur_agent_h), 1) AS "Estimate", ROUND(SUM(actual_agent_h), 1) AS "Actual"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') AND state = 'closed' AND tracked = 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT category AS "Category", ROUND(SUM(cur_agent_h), 1) AS "Estimate", ROUND(SUM(actual_agent_h), 1) AS "Actual"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') AND state = 'closed' AND tracked = 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Estimation accuracy over time (actual / estimate; 1.0 = perfect)
panels.description: Each point is a finished task. The rolling median should move towards 1.0 as /factory:plan learns from this product's history.

targets.queryText:
SELECT time, ratio AS "Task", rolling_median AS "Rolling median (last 10 tasks)"
FROM calibration_history WHERE product = '$product' ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT time, ratio AS "Task", rolling_median AS "Rolling median (last 10 tasks)"
FROM calibration_history WHERE product = '$product' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Calibration used by /factory:plan
panels.description: 'human' compares QA's after-the-fact human-dev estimate with the plan's human-dev estimate.

targets.queryText:
SELECT category AS "Category", samples AS "Samples", factor AS "Typical actual/estimate", p80 AS "80% within",
  CASE WHEN samples >= 3 THEN 'used' ELSE 'too few' END AS "Status"
FROM calibration WHERE product = '$product' ORDER BY CASE category WHEN 'all' THEN 0 WHEN 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, samples DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT category AS "Category", samples AS "Samples", factor AS "Typical actual/estimate", p80 AS "80% within",
  CASE WHEN samples >= 3 THEN 'used' ELSE 'too few' END AS "Status"
FROM calibration WHERE product = '$product' ORDER BY CASE category WHEN 'all' THEN 0 WHEN 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, samples DESC

panels.title: Human-dev estimate: plan vs QA after the work

targets.queryText:
SELECT tid AS "Task", cur_human_h AS "Plan", posthoc_human_h AS "QA after the work"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') AND posthoc_human_h IS NOT NULL ORDER BY closed_time
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT tid AS "Task", cur_human_h AS "Plan", posthoc_human_h AS "QA after the work"
FROM tasks WHERE product = '$product' AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR scope = '$scope') AND posthoc_human_h IS NOT NULL ORDER BY closed_time
